source_and_test_review: Closed duplicate-decoded-key/UTF-pair-aware4096UTF8 parser and exact root/version fields; primitive-only text; 1or2 records; canonical lowercase UUID/namespace and32-byte unpadded round-trip material including tail bits.
Safe integer epochs and checked300000ms retirement bound, half-open encryption/decryption eligibility, exact selected UUID, required future fixed-flow expiry and equality at decrypt cutoff.
Opaque frozen definition/resolved handles held only by private identity maps; copied/proxy/wrong-kind handles have no authority or policy/material access.

Real AES256 nonextractable native keys: current encrypt/decrypt, previous decrypt-only; neutral import does not globally reject a valid previous callback due to current future/expired state or a current begin due to expired previous.

Original attempt checked before creating each native import Promise, each actual wait and after completion; late rejection explicitly sunk, late success cannot cache/publish a resolved handle or begin second stage. Owned decoded buffers cleared on success/failure.

No shared pending imports/cache/clock/hash/crypto callback injection; repeated/concurrent imports use distinct native keys/handles; raw namespace binding stays private and complete selected policy immutable.

Actual real encryption/decryption rotation continuity, export denial, old-key encrypt denial, wrong-material/tag/namespace-AAD failure plus original attempt abort/expiry/end/regression and gated native late completion covered.
limitations: Independent review is of other-author capsule module/tests; reviewer authored scope/pool and earlier private adapter separately, which are excluded from this source verdict.
CPU instrumentation delegates to actual native WebCrypto; late-rejection delivery is explicitly synthetic fault injection, not a fabricated successful crypto key/result.
No physical zeroization of immutable strings/CryptoKeys or all engine internals is claimed.
Static policy cannot enforce cross-deployment UUID/material/cutoff history or instantaneous fleet revocation.

Test AAD is labelled synthetic; exact legacy AAD/transcript, cache snapshot binding, atomic SQL claim/ciphertext erasure, cross-isolate actual Workers, provider/cookie delivery and wholeU qualification remain common-core/integration obligations.
